catch_up_window.note: This run widens the usual 24h window to cover the full gap since the last successful run, per the ghl-ingest-agent catch-up precedent set for outlook on 2026-08-09. All window-scoped figures (new_leads, appointments_booked, conversations, pipeline_moves, won_today) cover these 14 days, not one day. Snapshot-based figures (leads_by_stage, opportunity_status_counts, stale/abandonment drift) reflect current state regardless of window and are unaffected by the gap.

data_quality_notes: 13 STORE: Material Pipeline opportunities sit in the '6a. Closed - Won' stage (totaling ~$23,412.52) and 4 in '6b. Closed - Lost' (~$33,816.13) while their opportunity `status` field is still 'open' — all dated 2025. These are excluded from won_today/store_wins_today because status is the ground-truth field per this agent's rules, but they likely represent real closed deals whose status was never flipped, understating historical store revenue reporting.

Two 'Albert Ngo' contacts (own name/phone/email used to test lead forms) exist in the live pipeline — one abandoned, one open in '1b. Postponed ' carrying both 'lead: cold' AND 'lead: warm' simultaneously. Internal test data, excluded from all reported items/metrics in this file, but polluting raw tag counts.
Contact ariel aradanas (SI6WqIHJje7miWAzsbwG) carries both 'lead: hot' and 'lead: unqualified' simultaneously — a second live example of conflicting qualification tags on one contact.

An 'abandoned-stale' tag appears on several contacts (e.g. EgzPlPLMnTSuqnBfYiLs, nmNDbMjdTnq3Ac5ZroVO, Yc3KfHQMlrwYLQp18fKD, IW7Y3ereJYFiVK4zuiGz) — this tag is not in the documented vocabulary (which states no 'abandoned' tag exists; abandonment is opportunity-status only).
